contracts.notes: Host-tested validation of a versioned handoff descriptor; not a complete firmware handoff.
Host-testable C11 lifecycle/runtime composition; not yet linked into the freestanding kernel.
Bounded deterministic dependency planner; it does not start services.

features.notes: Early kernel bring-up path; not a complete OS boot.
Independent BIOS/UEFI ISO target with separate readiness evidence.
Early allocator path exists; full VM, page-table policy, heap and isolation remain future gates.
Early exception and timer path; APIC/IOAPIC, SMP and complete interrupt-safe synchronization remain future work.
Host-testable deterministic graph planning only; no service execution or supervisor.
No stable user-mode syscall ABI is claimed.
No preemptive task scheduler is claimed.
No general process IPC is claimed.
No VFS or persistent storage subsystem is claimed.
No DMA isolation enforcement is claimed.
Manifest concepts and host policy integrations are not kernel capability enforcement.
No kernel network stack is claimed.
No graphical desktop or Vulkan compositor is claimed.
No transactional A/B OS updater is claimed.
SAMBU currently provides host-side language/tooling; no freestanding NUN target is claimed.
